_comment: Trimmed reversion grid focused on the new risk/regime/exit mechanics (2026-06-17). Entry + oscillator params are inherited from each ticker's calibrated DefaultParams (NOT swept) so walk-forward measures what the new layer adds on top of the baseline. Run with -risk-pct 1 so the catastrophic stop also anchors position size. ADXPeriod/ATRPeriod are pinned to 14 because the regime/ATR features need a non-zero period. Intended for rolling walk-forward (-train-months/-test-months), judged on per-fold consistency + parameter stability, not a single calibration.
